title: Planning gives an item that adds a brief or skill rule about scope a check that runs the scope predicate on the path the rule names, not only the rule's text
goal: precheck warns of a committed item whose goal adds a worker-brief or skill rule that calls a path in scope when every check only reads the rule's text, so planning adds a check that runs bl_base.in_scope (or done) on that path with a typical item's touches
notes: Retrospective of SP-q5ldd25k: ST-qqerasi3's check asserted the brief rule's wording and passed, but the rule calls a source row in scope while in_scope covers only the coverage files, so a content item whose touches lack _sources.csv is refused at done (the review's BG-6bb4zzdy). A check that ran in_scope on kb/public/_sources.csv with an article-only touch would have failed before the landing.
